name: Cosmozibs
niche: space and cosmic history for curious kids (9-15) and families
rules: every number needs a source URL in the episode JSON
no scary deaths or accidents with victims
never reuse a script with only the topic swapped (inauthentic content)
never copy titles, thumbnails or scripts of other channels: patterns only
no voice effects: no robot voices

tiktok.how: every Short goes to YouTube Shorts and TikTok in one Zernio post
tiktok.zernio_account: fill in tiktok.cosmozibs in studio/yt/zernio.json after zernio.yml cmd=accounts
tiktok.settings: public, comments/duet/stitch on, AI-generated label on
tiktok.limit: max 15 videos per 24 h per TikTok account (Zernio holds the rest)
